comments.author: Sophia
comments.body:
Quest Location : Lisbon , Merchant Guild - Merchant Mediator

Pre-Quest (This Quest Come First Before The Real Quest) :
Quest Name : "The Lovely Sweet Shop" 7 Star Quest.
Req : Cooking R10 , Portuguese Language , Trade fame 50.000 - 250.0000
Quest summary : Take 50 Baumkuchen to Christina on lisbon tavern , in 30 days.

"The Lovely Sweet Shop" Quest Reward : "Renowned Patissier's" cooking book.

Baumkuchen recipe book : "Confectioner's recipe" reward from investment at syracuse 300.000 D.
Required ingredient : Flour (2) , Sugar (2) , Egg (2). = 1 - 2 Baumkuchen.

Patissier Job Quest :
Quest Location : Lisbon , Merchant Guild - Merchant Mediator
Quest Name : "Carlotta makes up her mind" 8 Star Quest.
Req : Cooking R12 , Portuguese Language , Trade Fame 50.000 - 250.0000
Quest summary : Take Le poupelin (100) In 20 days. To christina in lisbon tavern.

"Carlotta makes up her mind" Quest Reward : First Grade Patissier Licence. Endorsment

Le poupelin recipe : "Renowned Patissier's" from "The Lovely Sweet Shop" Quest.
Required Ingredient : Flour (2) , Jam (1) , Vegetable Oil (1) = La Poupelin 1 - 2

Gratz.
